verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the agent side up to checkout completion: embedded mode manages the checkout lifecycle, and a `delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed` webhook signals that the purchase finished. Nothing documents an agent querying order status or shipment tracking after the purchase. The checkout-session statuses, `checkout.session.completed` events and Dashboard transaction views are seller-side, and the passing mention of 'fulfillment' in the lifecycle describes no agent-facing status or tracking capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
